frontMatter.about:
Gujarat Paraffins Pvt. Ltd. is a professionally managed organization engaged in the manufacturing and supply of paraffin-based products, serving a wide range of industrial applications. The company is committed to maintaining high standards of quality, operational efficiency, and regulatory compliance across all its operations.
With a focus on continuous improvement and responsible business practices, Gujarat Paraffins Pvt. Ltd. operates in accordance with applicable statutory requirements, industry standards, and ethical business principles. The organization emphasizes product consistency, customer satisfaction, and sustainable growth while ensuring a safe and respectful workplace for all employees.
Our success is driven by skilled employees, structured processes, and a commitment to operational excellence.
To set the benchmark for excellence in industrial waxes by delivering superior quality, fostering innovation, and making a positive impact on industries and communities worldwide.
- To offer world-class wax products tailored to industry needs.
- To uphold sustainability and social responsibility through cohesive initiatives.
- To continually innovate and maintain our position as a trusted global supplier.
Gujarat Paraffins Pvt. Ltd. promotes a professional, disciplined, and inclusive work culture where employees are encouraged to perform their duties responsibly and collaboratively. Key aspects of our work culture include:
- A safe and healthy working environment with emphasis on occupational health and safety.
- Respectful behavior, equal opportunity, and non-discrimination across all levels of the organization.
- Open communication between management and employees to address concerns constructively.

chapters.title: Discipline & Professional Conduct
chapters.text:
Maintaining discipline is essential for safety and productivity.
Employees are expected to:
- Follow company rules, policies, and procedures
- Maintain punctuality and regular attendance
- Demonstrate professional and responsible behavior
Any misconduct, negligence, or violation of policies may result in corrective or disciplinary action.
## Continuous Improvement Culture
The Company promotes a culture of continuous improvement and operational excellence.
- Employees are encouraged to:
- Identify inefficiencies and suggest improvements
- Contribute ideas for cost savings and process optimization
- Management supports initiatives that enhance:
- Productivity
- Safety
- Quality
- Sustainability
## Social Responsibility & Ethical Commitment
Gujarat Paraffins Pvt. Ltd. recognizes its responsibility toward society and the environment.
- Compliance with environmental and safety regulations
- Responsible use of resources
- Ethical dealings with all stakeholders
Employees are encouraged to contribute positively to both the workplace and the community.
## Company Policies
To support and uphold our cultural values, Gujarat Paraffins Pvt. Ltd. has established the following key policies:
- Prevention of Sexual Harassment (POSH)
- Harassment and Discrimination Guidelines
- Fair and Transparent Compensation
- Diversity, Inclusion, and Equal Opportunity
- Leave and Attendance Management
- Workplace Health, Safety, and Environment (HSE) Guidelines
- Whistleblower / Reporting Mechanism
- IT and Data Protection Guidelines
- Employee Conduct and Discipline Guidelines
- Training and Development Policy
These policies serve as a framework to ensure fairness, safety, ethical conduct, and professional growth across the organization.
## Recruitment, Selection & Joining Procedures
At Gujarat Paraffins Pvt. Ltd., we are committed to attracting, selecting, and onboarding competent and qualified individuals while ensuring transparency, fairness, and full compliance with applicable employment and labour laws. Our recruitment and selection practices are designed to support organizational growth, promote equal opportunity, prevent unethical labour practices, and provide a professional and positive candidate experience.
## Workforce Planning & Job Requirement Identification
- Workforce Planning:
- The HR department, in coordination with department heads, conducts periodic workforce planning to identify current and future manpower requirements.
- Recruitment decisions are based on production needs, operational expansion, replacement requirements, employee turnover, and business objectives.
- Job Analysis & Role Definition:
- Each vacancy undergoes a structured job analysis to define roles, responsibilities, qualifications, experience, skills, and reporting relationships.
- Job descriptions and role specifications are documented and approved by authorized management prior to initiating the recruitment process.
## Recruitment Process
- Internal Recruitment:
- Gujarat Paraffins Pvt. Ltd. encourages internal mobility by providing eligible employees opportunities to apply for vacant positions or promotions.
- Internal candidates are evaluated based on performance history, experience, skill set, and suitability for the role.
- External Recruitment:
- Open positions are advertised through appropriate channels such as job portals, recruitment agencies, local hiring sources, and direct applications.
- Efforts are made to attract a diverse pool of candidates and ensure equal employment opportunity.
- Screening and Shortlisting:
- Applications and resumes are reviewed by HR in coordination with the concerned department.
- Candidates are shortlisted based on qualifications, relevant experience, skill alignment, and job suitability.
- Age Verification:
- To prevent child labour, all job advertisements specify that candidates must meet the minimum legal age requirement for employment.
- Age verification is conducted through valid government-issued identification such as Aadhaar Card, Passport, Voter ID, or Driving License prior to selection.
## Selection Process
- Interviews:
- Shortlisted candidates undergo structured interviews, which may include HR interviews, technical assessments, and managerial discussions.
- Interview panels assess candidates based on job-related competencies, safety awareness, communication skills, experience, and cultural fit.
- Assessments:
- Depending on the role, candidates may be required to complete written tests, practical assessments, technical evaluations, or skill-based exercises.
- Reference Checks:
- References from previous employers or professional contacts may be verified to confirm employment history, performance, and conduct.
- Background verification, including identity, education, and experience checks, is conducted as per company policy.
- Equal Opportunity Commitment:
- Gujarat Paraffins Pvt. Ltd. follows a merit-based recruitment and selection approach.

chapters.title: Performance Management & Promotions
chapters.text:
- Promotions, pay revisions, and career advancement are linked to merit, competencies, and contribution.
- Employees are encouraged to apply for internal opportunities based on eligibility, performance, and potential.
- Appraisal outcomes are documented and shared transparently, with structured feedback for improvement.
## ncentives & Benefits
- Structured incentive programs reward individual and team achievements aligned with organizational objectives.
- Statutory benefits (PF, ESI, leave entitlements) and non-statutory benefits (medical coverage, insurance, travel allowances) are provided equitably to eligible employees.
- Benefits and perks are periodically reviewed to remain competitive and motivating.
## Special Provisions
- Reasonable accommodations are provided for employees with disabilities, medical conditions, or special needs, wherever operationally feasible.
- Exceptional contributions may be recognized through spot awards, performance bonuses, or recognition programs.
## Monitoring, Measurement & Reporting
- Compensation audits are conducted periodically to ensure fairness, consistency, and compliance.
- Analysis of salary distribution, incentives, and promotions is done to detect gaps or biases.
- Findings are reviewed by management and HR leadership, with corrective measures implemented where needed.
- Reports ensure transparency and accountability, providing data-driven insights to improve remuneration practices.
## Continuous Improvement & Periodic Review
- Remuneration policies are reviewed regularly to adapt to market trends, workforce evolution, and business priorities.
- Feedback from employees, supervisors, and industry benchmarking is incorporated to enhance fairness and competitiveness.
- New initiatives, such as revised incentive structures, flexible benefits, or recognition programs, are introduced to strengthen employee motivation and engagement.
- Continuous training and awareness programs are conducted for managers and HR personnel to ensure fair application of remuneration policies.
This framework ensures that every employee at Gujarat Paraffins Pvt. Ltd. is valued, fairly compensated, and motivated, while maintaining the company’s commitment to ethical practices, transparency, and compliance. It acts as a practical guide for decision-making, performance management, and career growth, reflecting the organization’s dedication to both its people and long-term sustainability.
## Employee Health and Safety
Gujarat Paraffins Pvt. Ltd. is firmly committed to ensuring a safe, healthy and secure working environment for all employees, contract workers, visitors, and other stakeholders present at its premises. The company considers occupational health and safety as a core operational responsibility and integrates safety considerations into all business activities.
All operations are carried out in compliance with applicable occupational health and safety laws, rules, and regulations. The company follows a preventive approach by identifying hazards, assessing risks, and implementing suitable control measures to prevent accidents, injuries, and occupational illnesses.
Safety is a shared responsibility, and every employee is expected to actively contribute to maintaining a safe workplace.
## Safety Equipment Provision & Usage
Gujarat Paraffins Pvt. Ltd. ensures the provision, use, and monitoring of Personal Protective Equipment (PPE) in accordance with identified workplace hazards and applicable safety regulations, including the Factories Act, 1948.
## mplementation Framework
- PPE requirements are defined through job-specific hazard identification and risk assessment (HIRA).
- A PPE Matrix is maintained for all departments specifying:
- Type of PPE required
- Applicable job roles
- Mandatory usage zones
## Provision & Control
- PPE is issued free of cost, recorded, and periodically replaced based on usage and condition.
- Critical PPE (e.g., respirators, ear protection) is subject to fit checks and usability verification.
## Employee Compliance Requirements
Employees shall:
- Wear PPE at all designated locations (no exceptions).
- Perform basic pre-use checks (damage, fit, cleanliness).
- Immediately report unsafe or defective PPE.
## Monitoring & Enforcement
- Supervisors conduct routine PPE compliance checks.
- Non-compliance is recorded and may lead to progressive disciplinary action, as it constitutes a safety violation.
Gujarat Paraffins Pvt. Ltd. has established a structured Performance Management System (PMS) to align individual performance with organizational objectives, operational efficiency, and continuous improvement.
The system is designed to:
- Establish clear and measurable performance expectations
- Drive accountability and ownership at all levels
- Enable continuous monitoring and feedback
- Identify development needs and support employee growth
- Facilitate fair and objective performance evaluation

chapters.title: Training and Awareness on Health and Safety
chapters.text:
Gujarat Paraffins Pvt. Ltd. ensures that employees are adequately trained to perform their duties safely and responsibly.
- Safety induction training is mandatory for all new employees, trainees, and contract workers before they commence work.
- Periodic refresher training is conducted to reinforce safe working practices.
- Training programs cover, but are not limited to:
- General workplace safety rules
- Safe operation of machinery and tools
- Chemical safety and labeling awareness
- Use and maintenance of PPE
- Fire prevention and emergency response
- First aid awareness
- Good housekeeping practices
- Safety instructions, signage, and warning notices are displayed at prominent locations.
## Tracking & Effectiveness
- Training attendance and records are documented and maintained.
- Effectiveness is evaluated through:
- Tool-box talks
- On-site observations
- Periodic assessments
- Employees are expected to actively participate in safety training sessions and follow the guidance provided.
## Occupational Emergency Management Plan
The company has established a documented Emergency Action Plan to effectively respond to emergencies and minimize harm to employees, property, and the environment.
- The emergency plan addresses situations such as:
- Fire and explosion
- Chemical spills or leaks
- Medical emergencies
- Electrical failures
- Natural disasters
- Firefighting equipment, alarms, emergency lighting, and safety signage are installed and maintained.
- Employees must follow emergency instructions, cooperate during drills, and evacuate promptly when required.
## Preparedness Measures
- Clearly marked evacuation routes and assembly points
- Availability of:
- Fire extinguishers and hydrant systems
- Emergency alarms and lighting
- Spill control kits
## Emergency Response System
- Defined roles and responsibilities (Emergency Response Team)
- Availability of trained first-aiders
- Coordination with external emergency services
## Testing & Readiness
- Mock drills conducted at periodic intervals
- Post-drill evaluations to identify gaps and improvements
## Employee Obligation
Employees must:
- Follow alarm signals and evacuation protocols
- Participate in drills
- Avoid panic and assist in safe evacuation
## Workplace Health & Safety Risk Evaluation
We conduct periodic health and safety risk assessments to identify, evaluate, and control workplace hazards.
- Risk assessments cover work processes, machinery, storage areas, chemical usage, maintenance activities, and manual handling.
- Identified risks are evaluated based on severity and likelihood.
- Appropriate control measures are implemented, including:
- Engineering controls
- Administrative controls
- Safe work procedures
- PPE usage
- Risk assessments are reviewed regularly and whenever there is a change in process, equipment, or layout.
- Employees are encouraged to report unsafe conditions, unsafe acts, or near-miss incidents to supervisors without fear of retaliation.
## Workforce Health Care & Insurance Benefits
Gujarat Paraffins Pvt. Ltd. ensures the health and well-being of its workforce through adequate medical facilities, preventive health measures, and insurance coverage, in line with applicable provisions of the Factories Act, 1948 and Employees’ State Insurance Act, 1948 (ESI Act).
## Medical Facilities & Support
- First-aid facilities are available across all operational areas and are regularly maintained.
- Trained first-aiders are available during working hours.
- In case of injury or illness, immediate medical assistance is provided and, if required, employees are referred to nearby medical facilities.
## Preventive Health Measures
- Pre-employment and periodic medical check-ups are conducted for employees exposed to occupational risks.
- Basic health monitoring is carried out for exposure to dust, chemicals, or noise, wherever applicable.
## nsurance & Coverage
- Eligible employees are covered under statutory schemes such as ESI or other medical insurance as per company policy.
- Employees are informed about available medical benefits and claim procedures.
## Workplace Injury Management
- All work-related injuries and illnesses are recorded and provided with necessary medical treatment.
- Employees may resume duties only after fitness confirmation, wherever applicable.
## Confidentiality of Records
- Employee medical records are maintained securely and treated as confidential.
## Accident, Incident, and Near-Miss Reporting
- Gujarat Paraffins Pvt. Ltd. maintains a structured system for reporting and managing accidents, incidents, and near-misses to prevent recurrence and improve workplace safety, in line with applicable provisions of the Factories Act, 1948.
## Reporting Requirements
- All accidents, injuries, unsafe incidents, and near-misses must be reported immediately or within the same shift to the supervisor or safety personnel.
- Delayed or non-reporting of incidents is considered a safety non-compliance.

chapters.title: Overtime Compensation
chapters.text:
- Employees shall be paid overtime wages at 1.5 times (1.5x) the ordinary rate of wages, as per company policy.
- Alternatively, compensatory off may be provided where applicable.
- Overtime payments will be processed along with the regular payroll cycle.
## Employee Responsibility
- Employees are expected to plan and complete work within standard working hours.
- Repeated reliance on overtime due to poor planning may be reviewed by management.
## Declared Holidays & Rest Day Framework
Each year, Gujarat Paraffins Pvt. Ltd. issues an Annual Holiday Calendar in accordance with applicable statutory requirements and operational needs.
## Holiday Coverage
The calendar includes:
- National holidays
- Festival holidays
- Statutory holidays as mandated by applicable laws
## Guidelines
- The approved holiday list will be communicated in advance to all employees.
- Holidays are fixed and applicable as per the declared calendar.
- Substitution, adjustment, or clubbing of holidays with leave to extend time off is not permitted without prior approval from the reporting manager.
## Attendance Impact on Employment Evaluation
Attendance discipline directly influences:
- Confirmation of employment during probation
- Performance appraisal outcomes
- Promotion and role enhancement considerations
- Salary revision and incentive eligibility
Persistent non-compliance with attendance norms may result in disciplinary action.
## Continuous Improvement & Periodic Review
Gujarat Paraffins Pvt. Ltd. periodically reviews attendance and working hour practices to ensure effectiveness, fairness, and statutory compliance.
- Attendance trends and working hour data are monitored to identify gaps or improvement areas.
- Policies and procedures are reviewed in line with operational changes and legal updates.
- Corrective actions are implemented where required, and employees are informed of any significant changes.
## Leave and Attendance Management
The Company recognizes the importance of maintaining a healthy work–life balance and understands that employees may require time away from work for rest, medical needs, personal responsibilities, and family commitments. The Leave Administration & Absence Control Framework ensures that leave entitlements are granted in a fair, transparent, and consistent manner while remaining compliant with applicable labour laws. This section outlines available leave categories, eligibility criteria, approval processes, and documentation requirements.
The leave management system is designed to:
- Support employee well-being, rest, and recovery.
- Ensure operational continuity while accommodating employee needs.
- Maintain fairness, consistency, and transparency in leave allocation.
- Enable accurate tracking and reporting through HR records or systems.
- Ensure compliance with statutory and organizational requirements.
## Leave Request & Authorization Guidelines
- All leave requests must be submitted through the prescribed HR system or formal written communication to the reporting manager.
- Planned leave should be applied for in advance, except in emergency or medical situations.
- Approval of leave is subject to workload, departmental requirements, and managerial discretion.
- Unauthorized absence will be treated as Leave Without Pay (LWP) and may attract disciplinary action.
- Employees must inform their immediate supervisor promptly in case of sudden or unplanned absence.
- Misrepresentation, misuse of leave, or falsification of records may result in corrective or disciplinary action.
## Categories of Leave Entitlements
## Annual Accrued Leave (Privilege / Earned Leave)
Annual Accrued Leave is provided to enable employees to plan extended time off for personal, family, or social commitments.
Key Provisions
- 18 days per year (accrued at approximately 1.5 days per month)
- Suitable for planned or long-duration absences
- Advance application required (7–15 days prior)
- Subject to approval by the reporting manager and HR
- Accumulation permitted up to 45 days
- Leave encashment may be allowed at the time of full and final settlement, as per policy.
Typical Usage
- Family events or ceremonies
- Personal travel or vacations
- Relocation or extended personal commitments
## Short-Term Personal Leave (Casual Leave)
Short-Term Personal Leave is intended for urgent or unforeseen personal matters requiring brief absence.
Key Provisions
## –7 days per year
- Generally limited to 1–2 days at a time
- Supervisor must be informed at the earliest possible time
- Cannot be clubbed with holidays or long weekends without approval
- Not eligible for carry forward or encashment.
Common Reasons
- Urgent personal or family matters
- Government or banking work
- Childcare or family support needs
## Medical Recovery Leave (Sick Leave)
Medical Recovery Leave supports employees during illness, injury, or medical treatment.
Key Provisions
## –7 days per year
- Applicable when an employee is unfit to attend work due to health reasons.

chapters.title: Flexible Working Hours (Flexi-Time Model)
chapters.text:
- Employees may vary start and end times within defined operational limits.
- Core working hours may be established to ensure team coordination.
- Total working hours must comply with company policy and labour laws.
## Job-Sharing Arrangement
- Two employees may jointly share one full-time position.
- Roles, responsibilities, schedules, and accountability are clearly defined.
- Coordination and continuity of work are mandatory.
- Performance evaluation considers shared outcomes and individual contributions.
## ariable or Compressed Work Schedules
- Employees may work extended hours on certain days in exchange for reduced hours or additional days off.
- Such arrangements must comply with statutory limits on working hours and rest periods.
- Health, safety, and fatigue management are key considerations.
## Application & Approval Process
- Employees must submit a formal request specifying:
- Type of flexibility requested
- Proposed duration (temporary or ongoing)
- Expected impact on work delivery
- Requests are reviewed by the reporting manager and HR.
- Approval is granted based on business feasibility, employee performance, and role suitability.
- Approved arrangements are documented, including terms, review periods, and conditions.
## Performance Monitoring & Review
- Employees on flexible arrangements are subject to regular performance reviews.
- Effectiveness, attendance, productivity, and communication are assessed.
- Adjustments may be made based on business needs or performance outcomes.
## Modification, Withdrawal & Policy Review
- The Company reserves the right to modify, suspend, or withdraw flexible working arrangements if:
- Business requirements change
- Performance expectations are not met
- Health, safety, or security risks arise
- This policy is reviewed periodically to ensure alignment with legal, operational, and organizational requirements.
- Employee feedback is considered as part of continuous improvement efforts.
## Prevention of Harassment and Discrimination Measures
Gujarat Paraffins Pvt. Ltd. is committed to maintaining a safe, respectful, inclusive, and equitable work environment. The Company strictly enforces a zero-tolerance policy toward harassment, discrimination, bullying, or any behavior that undermines the dignity, safety, or equality of individuals. This policy applies to all employees and stakeholders to ensure that the workplace is free from any form of inappropriate behavior or unfair treatment.
The objectives of this policy are to:
- Promote a workplace free of harassment and discrimination.
- Ensure equitable and respectful treatment of all employees, contractors, trainees, and visitors.
- Foster a positive, inclusive, and bias-free work culture.
- Comply with applicable labor laws, regulations, and ethical standards.
- Provide clear reporting and resolution mechanisms for complaints.
- Encourage early detection, prevention, and awareness of inappropriate behavior.
- Build employee confidence in fair and accountable grievance handling.
## Scope & Applicability
This policy applies to:
- All employees including permanent, contractual, temporary, trainees, apprentices, and interns.
- All stages of employment, including recruitment, onboarding, training, performance appraisal, promotion, compensation, transfers, and separation.
- All workplace environments, including offices, production units, laboratories, off-site assignments, training programs, business travel, and company-sponsored events.
- Interactions with external stakeholders, such as vendors, clients, contractors, and visitors, while performing official duties.
## Definitions
Harassment: Any unwelcome conduct—verbal, non-verbal, physical, or visual—that humiliates, intimidates, or offends an individual. Examples include:
- Unwanted sexual advances, comments, or gestures.
- Bullying, threats, intimidation, or coercion.
- Offensive jokes, messages, gestures, or images.
- Repeated unwelcome attention, communication, or social media harassment.
Discrimination: Unfair treatment of individuals based on gender, age, caste, religion, nationality, disability, sexual orientation, marital status, or other protected characteristics. Examples include:
- Unequal opportunities for promotion, training, or incentives.
- Bias in recruitment, appraisal, or work assignments.
- Denial of benefits or access to resources based on personal characteristics.
Victimization: Retaliatory action against employees who report harassment or discrimination or participate in investigations.
Sexual Harassment (as per POSH Act, India): Any unwelcome act, gesture, or behavior of a sexual nature including physical contact, advances, requests for sexual favors, or any conduct that creates a hostile environment.
## Reporting Mechanisms
Employees are encouraged to report harassment or discrimination without fear of retaliation.
- Reports may be made to:
- HR Department
- Immediate Supervisor or Manager

chapters.title: Grievance Resolution Committee (GRC)
chapters.text:
For complex, sensitive, or escalated cases, a Grievance Resolution Committee is constituted.
## Composition:
- Senior Management Representative
- Head – HR
- Departmental Representative
- Neutral member (outside concerned department)
## Roles and Responsibilities:
- Conduct structured hearings
- Review evidence and statements
- Ensure fair and unbiased evaluation
- Recommend appropriate actions
All proceedings are documented, and records are securely maintained.
## Severe Misconduct
In cases where grievances involve serious violations, immediate action is initiated.
## Examples of Severe Misconduct:
- Theft, fraud, or financial irregularities
- Harassment, intimidation, or workplace violence
- Substance abuse during work hours
- Misuse of authority or company resources
- Damage to company or stakeholder property
## Procedure:
- Initiation of confidential investigation within 24–48 hours
- Protection of complainant identity
- Temporary actions (if required) such as suspension
- Final disciplinary action based on findings
## Escalation and Review
If the individual is not satisfied with the outcome:
- The grievance may be escalated to a higher authority or HR
- A re-evaluation will be conducted
- A final decision will be communicated within a reasonable timeframe
## Handling of Serious or Sensitive Grievances
In cases involving serious matters such as harassment, discrimination, safety violations, or misconduct:
- The grievance will be handled directly by HR or the appropriate committee.
- Immediate investigation will be initiated.
- Necessary action will be taken as per company policies and applicable laws.
Non-Retaliation: The Company strictly prohibits retaliation against any employee who raises a grievance in good faith. Any form of retaliation will be treated as misconduct and may result in disciplinary action.
Confidentiality: All grievances are handled with strict confidentiality. Information is shared only with authorized personnel involved in the resolution process.
## Accessibility and Awareness
- The mechanism is communicated during onboarding
- Details are available in the handbook and through HR
- Multiple reporting options ensure accessibility for all employees, including shopfloor workers
## Record Keeping and Continuous Improvement
- All grievances are recorded and maintained by HR.
- Periodic review is conducted to identify recurring issues and areas for improvement.
- Corrective measures are implemented to strengthen workplace practices and prevent similar concerns in the future
## Controls for Protection of Third-Party Data
Gujarat Paraffin Pvt. Ltd. is committed to protecting the confidentiality, integrity, and security of third-party data entrusted to the Company by customers, suppliers, contractors, service providers, business partners, and other external stakeholders. These measures establish systematic controls to prevent unauthorized access, misuse, loss, alteration, or disclosure of third-party information and to ensure compliance with contractual obligations, data protection laws, and ethical business practices.
## Scope
These measures apply to:
- All third-party data received, processed, stored, or transmitted by the Company
- All employees, consultants, contractors, temporary staff, vendors, and authorized users
- All formats of third-party data including digital, physical, verbal, and electronic records
- All IT systems, ERP platforms, email systems, cloud services, databases, and physical storage locations
## Definition of Third-Party Data
Third-party data includes, but is not limited to:
- Customer information (contact details, orders, commercial terms)
- Supplier and vendor information (contracts, pricing, bank details)
- Contractor and service provider records
- Confidential business information shared under agreements
- Personal data belonging to external stakeholders
## Data Classification & Handling Controls
- Third-party data is classified as Confidential or Highly Confidential by default unless stated otherwise
- Data handling procedures are aligned with the sensitivity of the information
- Access, storage, transmission, and disposal of third-party data follow defined security controls
- Confidentiality markings are applied to documents and files wherever applicable
## Access Control & Authorization
- Access to third-party data is granted strictly on a Need-to-Know and Least Privilege basis
- Only authorized employees whose roles require access are permitted to handle third-party data
- Unique user IDs and passwords are assigned to all system users
- Multi-Factor Authentication (MFA) is implemented for critical systems where feasible
- Access rights are reviewed periodically and revoked immediately upon role change, transfer, or separation
## Technical & IT Security Measures
- Third-party data stored in digital systems is protected using firewalls, antivirus, anti-malware, and endpoint security tools
